name: Shared components
responsibility: The composite components and the class-name rule that every surface draws with
description: The twenty names of ui-kit's ./components entry: one composite per job over the shadcn Base UI items, a family's parts on its root (Dialog.Content, Select.Item), with cn, the platform's command key and a repository's shown name beside them. buttonVariants is private behind Button (TASK-653.17): the Base UI triggers render a Button, and Button's href branch draws a plain link with the same classes and no Base UI primitive, because Base UI gives a non-native element role=button; the shell's notices use it.
